say:2:1460117001:1.text: After an exhilarating sparring session, you return once more to the Traveler's Light...
say:2:1460117001:1.source_cn: 在一场愉快的切磋后，你们再次回到了旅人灯火……

say:3:1460117002:1.text: Valen's swordplay cut deep—not just with speed or power, but with purpose behind every strike.

say:4:1460117003:1.text: In the blink of an eye, he vanished and reappeared behind his foe, moving like a shadow, striking with the calm certainty of one who no longer guesses.
say:4:1460117003:1.source_cn: 在转瞬间迅速转换位置，直切后方进行袭击，犹如鬼魅般的身手。

say:5:1460117004:1.text: But above all, it was the sword aura—quiet, steady—that spoke loudest. True strength often needs no flourish.

say:7:1460117006:1.text: Most folks need a bruised ego or two before they figure out I'm not all flash and footwork.
say:7:1460117006:1.source_cn: 大部分人至少要在我手上吃过几次亏，才会知道我不是光靠着...

say:8:1460117007:1.text: No wonder <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s dragging you around like a prized pupil.
